name: Tank 4 · goats + fire (SE)
notes:
New tank on the high (south) side of the south-east goat zone, about 124 m, beside the south firebreak. Size: 5–10 kL. Drag it to the exact spot on site.
Jobs: gravity-feeds goat troughs downhill in the goat zone (float valves), and holds a fire reserve with a 50 mm outlet and Storz fitting for a fire pump, kept topped up and marked for the fire service. Put the goat outlet a quarter of the way up the tank, so the bottom quarter is always kept for firefighting.
Filled by: Bunyip line 2 (southern edge), extended east from Tank 3 along the firebreak; roof catch from a small shed or shelter over the tank where possible.
Ready before goats go in (May 2027).
